content.description: Exploded view diagram showing starter motor assembly with flywheel bellhousing. The diagram shows the starter motor unit and separate components including what appears to be mounting hardware and connector pieces.

items:
INSTALL STARTER MOTOR IN FLYWHEEL BELLHOUSING
Place the starter motor in the flywheel bellhousing. Install the two bolts.

CONNECT TWO WIRES TO STARTER
Connect the connector to the terminal on the magnetic switch. Connect the cable from the battery to the terminal on the switch, and install the nut.

CONNECT CABLE TO NEGATIVE TERMINAL OF BATTERY
Check that the car starts.
